mentions.name: Set-top box photo display app
mentions.description: A first app for the author's set-top box that accepts a photo posted from an iPhone via iOS Shortcuts and displays it on the TV; it currently accepts only one photo at a time.
mentions.source_excerpt: I learnt about my set-up box, and got assistance in making my first app, so I can post and image from my iphone to it via shortcuts. Currently, it only accepts one photo, but it is cool throwing it up on the tv.
mentions.author: freshteapot
